missions.name: Health
missions.question: How do we keep people healthier, longer?
highlights: PurlStead, a student-built iPad app, screens for early signs of Parkinson's disease with on-device AI — a Distinguished Winner of Apple's Swift Student Challenge 2026.
Paperplane, founded by School of Computing students, runs digital clinics for doctors on WhatsApp.

missions.name: Mobility
missions.question: How will the next billion people move?
highlights: Volvo Group's first university-based Vehicle Technology Centre is at SRMIST.
Team Camber Racing — National Champions, Formula Bharat 2026 (combustion category).

missions.name: Space & Materials
missions.question: What will we build with, and where will we go?
highlights: The Nanotechnology Research Centre, set up in 2006 at Kattankulathur, makes and studies new materials for energy, environment and healthcare.

missions.name: Sustainability
missions.question: How do we grow without using up the planet?
highlights: Ranked 4 in NIRF 2025 Sustainability (SDG), as published by SRM.
Zero-cement geopolymer concrete — made from industrial by-products such as fly ash — is already on campus as a building, a precast toilet block, paver blocks and an internal road.
